params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, pictureObject below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, pictureObject is a Variable/Field reference.

params.name: pictureObject
params.description: Object name (if * passed) or Variable/field reference (if * omitted)

params.name: id
params.description: ID attribute of element to display

params.name: margin
params.description: Margin of visibility in pixels; defaults to 4 pixels if omitted.

overloads.semanticRole: Moves the pictureObject SVG document so the element identified by id becomes visible, expanding its bounding rectangle by margin pixels.

constraints: This command only takes effect in "top left" display mode (with scrollbars).
If the command is not executed in the context of a form, or an invalid pictureObject is passed, the OK system variable is set to 0; otherwise it is set to 1.
